header.definition: C = measure{a in [0,18] : L(a)=1 and H(a)=0} / 18; L from the reviewed label verdict (verify = unknown: lower bound 0, upper bound 1); H from age-specific cautions extracted by regular expressions (verbatim sentences). Weight cut-offs are flagged, not converted.
header.heuristic: Extraction is by regular expressions over label sections and must be verified by hand; a caution about one indication is applied to the whole age range.
header.not_a_recommendation: This is NOT a recommendation of treatment and NOT dosing advice. No dose is computed. The age of the patient is unknown and is never assumed.
header.purpose: Label support under an unknown patient age: the fraction of the paediatric age range 0-18 years over which the US label supports use and no age-specific label warning contradicts it.
